answer.main_body: horizontally laid heat sink / radiator panel on a mounted base
answer.evidence: The main body is a horizontal panel viewed from above in 3/4 perspective. Its top surface spans rows 1 to 16, displaying receding fins and tapered perspective, while the front edge and mounting base occupy rows 17 to 29.

answer.main_body: horizontal heat sink panel with fins on top surface
answer.evidence: Rows 1-17 clearly depict the top horizontal surface of the panel foreshortened in 3/4 view with north-south heatsink fins and trapezoidal perspective tapering, while rows 18-29 show the south front face, trim, and mounting feet.

The top surface of the panel is prominently foreshortened and visible from row 1 to 16 (16 rows tall) with vertical fins receding north-south, above the layered south-facing front edge (rows 17-25) and feet.

answer.main_body: laid-flat heat dissipation panel with vertical cooling fins on its top surface and a banded front face supported on feet
answer.evidence: The top surface of the horizontal panel spans rows 1 through 17 with clear trapezoidal foreshortening (narrower at the back, wider at the front) and longitudinal fin lines, while rows 18-25 form the south front face resting on base feet.
